description: All marketing and promotional communications crafted by Brick & Beyond must maintain a consultative, articulate, and transparent tone. Communications must position the agency and client as trusted real estate advisors. High-pressure sales tactics, sensationalist slogans, and unsubstantiated hype are strictly prohibited across all marketing media.

rule_title: Clear Attribution and Mandatory Marketing Disclosures
description: Every public-facing advertisement, digital landing page, email campaign, and social media creative must explicitly identify the developer entity, official project title, project location, and mandatory statutory registrations. Content must be legible, unambiguous, and accompanied by applicable disclaimers in at least 8-point font or standard on-screen display duration.

rule_title: Prohibition of Deceptive Connectivity and Civic Infrastructure Claims
description: Marketing content must never misrepresent travel times, civic infrastructure completion dates, or proximity to landmarks. Travel times must be stated with objective qualifications (e.g., 'approx. 15 minutes drive under standard traffic conditions'). Planned public transit lines or flyovers cannot be described as operational unless officially commissioned by municipal authorities.

rule_title: Substantiation Required for Superlative and Absolute Language
description: Use of superlatives including 'best', 'largest', 'first-ever', 'most luxurious', 'unmatched', or 'exclusive' is prohibited unless substantiated by an active, verifiable third-party certification, industry award, or architectural fact on record. In the absence of documented verification, copywriters must use neutral, descriptive language (e.g., 'premium', 'well-appointed', 'spacious').

rule_title: Strict Adherence to Approved Client Specifications
description: All numerical data, unit dimensions, carpet areas, pricing structures, payment schemes, and amenity lists must strictly originate from current client-approved project sheets. Copywriters and marketing managers are expressly barred from estimating or modifying property specifications without formal written client addenda.

rule_title: Strict Prohibition of Guaranteed Returns and Capital Appreciation Promises
description: Real estate marketing copy must never guarantee, promise, or assure investment returns, capital appreciation percentages, or fixed rental yields. Claims such as 'guaranteed 12% rental return' or 'double your investment in 3 years' are statutory violations. Illustrative financial returns must explicitly carry the disclaimer: 'Investment is subject to market risks. Projections are indicative and not guaranteed.'

rule_title: Mandatory Registration Reference and Authority Portal Display
description: Pursuant to real estate regulatory governance, every communication promoting a registered real estate project must prominently display the official project registration reference and official authority website URL. For demonstration datasets, an explicit fictional reference starting with the DEMO- prefix must be visible.

rule_title: Prohibition of Fabricated Urgency and False Scarcity
description: Claims of limited unit availability (e.g., 'only 2 penthouses remaining' or 'booking window closes in 24 hours') must be substantiated by real-time inventory management logs approved by the developer. Fabricating artificial scarcity or false deadline pressure to induce hasty buying decisions is strictly prohibited.
